arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and says it can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement themselves, which would stay their property and go with them when they leave. Please decide: (a) we send our contractor to inspect/repair your machine, (b) you arrange your own contractor, or (c) consent to the tenant's replacement on their terms.
options: Our contractor inspects/repairs the existing machine (recommended first step)
Consent to tenant fitting their own machine; please say who pays to disconnect and remove your LG and fit the new one, and what should happen to your LG (inspect, repair, dispose)
arguments.update: Routine job, no contractor assigned yet. The tenant's own machine would not be on the inventory and would remain theirs. Please reply by 2025-07-29.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with their own. This needs landlord consent (alterations); not a repair. arguments.decision_needed: The tenant reports the LG washing machine (provided with the flat) has a power failure and says it can't be fixed. They offer to buy a replacement themselves, which would stay their property and go with them when they leave. Please decide: (a) we send our contractor to inspect/repair your machine, (b) you arrange your own contractor, or (c) consent to the tenant's replacement on their terms.
options: Our contractor inspects/repairs the existing machine (recommended first step)
Consent to tenant fitting their own machine; please say who pays to disconnect and remove your LG and fit the new one, and what should happen to your LG (inspect, repair, dispose)
arguments.update: Routine job, no contractor assigned yet. The tenant's own machine would not be on the inventory and would remain theirs. Please reply by 2025-07-29.

arguments.note: Tenant wants to replace landlord's LG washer with their own. This needs landlord consent (alterations); not a repair. Tenant's machine stays theirs, not on inventory, taken at move-out. Open: landlord decision, who pays disconnect/removal/fit, fate of landlord's LG, whether tenant's can stay connected. Tenant's "can't be fixed" is from googling, unverified.

arguments.body: Hi, thanks for letting us know about the washing machine. Because the machine belongs to the landlord, we need their consent before you swap it for your own. We've asked them, including the point that your machine would stay yours and go with you when you leave, and who covers removing the old one. Please don't disconnect or dispose of the LG yet. If you can, send a photo of the machine and any error code. We'll update you by 29 July.
